name: ZSF_FCST_COMMON_ATTR_B
description: Base table for storing common attributes for forecasting application

columns.name: FCST_COMMON_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for the common attributes table, storing the seeded attributes

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Table Name having the criteria attribute (eg- MOO_REVN)

columns.name: COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Column Name of the criteria in the parent table (eg: MOO_REVN)

columns.name: ATTR_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute Code for the criteria attribute

columns.name: CRITERIA_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the current row is a criteria row

columns.name: DISPCLMN_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the current row is a display column row.

columns.name: DEFAULT_DISPCLMN_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the current row is a default display column

columns.name: ATTR_UI_TYPE
columns.description: The UI type of the attribute, eg : dropdown, text etc

columns.name: FIELD_OPERATOR_TYPE
columns.description: Operator type for the current criteria column.

columns.name: LOOKUP_NAME
columns.description: Name of the lookup that has the criteria values.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
